## US Stocks Finish Wild July Higher as Amazon Surges, Apple Sinks, Inflation Worries Persist

The sharp AMZN/AAPL divergence within large-cap tech at July month-end is a composition signal for index-weighted portfolios. Worsening inflation framing adds caution on rate-sensitive multiples and complicates the macro setup heading into August.

- US equities rallied into July month-end despite a volatile month, per broad market coverage across five outlets.
- Amazon was the standout outperformer on the day; Apple was the standout laggard — the two moves are treated as the defining stock-level stories.
- Inflation worries are described as worsening, framed as the dominant macro backdrop through the close.
- Coverage is market-wrap in nature; the company-specific drivers are captured in individual clusters.
